versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י בִשְׁמוֹנִ֣ים שָׁנָ֣ה וְאַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֣וֹת שָׁנָ֡ה לְצֵ֣את בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מֵאֶֽרֶץ־מִצְרַיִם֩ בַּשָּׁנָ֨ה הָרְבִיעִ֜ית בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ זִ֗ו ה֚וּא הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י לִמְלֹ֥ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּ֥בֶן הַבַּ֖יִת לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build Yahweh’s house.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the Lord.
controles.livre: E foi no ano quatrocentos oitenta depois que os filhos de Israel saíram do Egito, no quarto ano do princípio do reino de Salomão sobre Israel, no mês de Zife, que é o mês segundo, que ele começou a edificar a casa do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְהַבַּ֗יִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֜ה הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁשִּֽׁים־אַמָּ֥ה אָרְכּ֖וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים רָחְבּ֑וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The house which king Solomon built for Yahweh, its length was sixty cubits, and its breadth twenty, and its height thirty cubits.
controles.kjv: And the house which king Solomon built for the Lord, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.
controles.livre: A casa que o rei Salomão edificou ao SENHOR, teve sessenta côvados de comprimento e vinte de largura, e trinta côvados de altura.

versos.hebraico: וְהָאוּלָ֗ם עַל־פְּנֵי֙ הֵיכַ֣ל הַבַּ֔יִת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ עַל־פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֣חַב הַבָּ֑יִת עֶ֧שֶׂר בָּאַמָּ֛ה רָחְבּ֖וֹ עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַבָּֽיִת׃

controles.web: The porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was its length, according to the breadth of the house. Ten cubits was its breadth before the house.
controles.kjv: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
controles.livre: E o pórtico diante do templo da casa, de vinte côvados de comprimento, segundo a largura da casa, e sua largura era de dez côvados diante da casa.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לַבָּ֔יִת חַלּוֹנֵ֖י שְׁקֻפִ֥ים אֲטֻמִֽים׃

controles.web: For the house he made windows of fixed lattice work.
controles.kjv: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
controles.livre: E fez à casa janelas largas por de dentro, e estreitas por de fora.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּבֶן֩ עַל־קִ֨יר הַבַּ֤יִת יצוע סָבִ֔יב אֶת־קִיר֤וֹת הַבַּ֨יִת֙ סָבִ֔יב לַֽהֵיכָ֖ל וְלַדְּבִ֑יר וַיַּ֥עַשׂ צְלָע֖וֹת סָבִֽיב׃

controles.web: Against the wall of the house he built stories all around, against the walls of the house all around, both of the temple and of the oracle; and he made side rooms all around.
controles.kjv: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
controles.livre: Edificou também junto ao muro da casa aposentos ao redor, contra as paredes da casa em derredor do templo e do compartimento interno: e fez câmaras ao redor.

versos.hebraico: היצוע הַתַּחְתֹּנָ֜ה חָמֵ֧שׁ בָּאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבָּ֗הּ וְהַתִּֽיכֹנָה֙ שֵׁ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔הּ וְהַ֨שְּׁלִישִׁ֔ית שֶׁ֥בַע בָּאַמָּ֖ה רָחְבָּ֑הּ כִּ֡י מִגְרָעוֹת֩ נָתַ֨ן לַבַּ֤יִת סָבִיב֙ ח֔וּצָה לְבִלְתִּ֖י אֲחֹ֥ז בְּקִֽירוֹת־הַבָּֽיִת׃

controles.web: The nethermost story was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not have hold in the walls of the house.
controles.kjv: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
controles.livre: O aposento de abaixo era de cinco côvados de largura, e o de em meio de seis côvados de largura, e o terceiro de sete côvados de largura: porque por de fora havia feito apoios à casa em derredor, para não introduzir as vigas nas paredes da casa.

versos.hebraico: וְהַבַּ֨יִת֙ בְּהִבָּ֣נֹת֔וֹ אֶֽבֶן־שְׁלֵמָ֥ה מַסָּ֖ע נִבְנָ֑ה וּמַקָּב֤וֹת וְהַגַּרְזֶן֙ כָּל־כְּלִ֣י בַרְזֶ֔ל לֹֽא־נִשְׁמַ֥ע בַּבַּ֖יִת בְּהִבָּנֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The house, when it was in building, was built of stone prepared at the quarry; and there was neither hammer nor ax nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
controles.kjv: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
controles.livre: E a casa quando se edificou, fabricaram-na de pedras que traziam já acabadas; de tal maneira que quando a edificavam, nem martelos nem machados se ouviram na casa, nem nenhum outro instrumento de ferro.

versos.hebraico: פֶּ֗תַח הַצֵּלָע֙ הַתִּ֣יכֹנָ֔ה אֶל־כֶּ֥תֶף הַבַּ֖יִת הַיְמָנִ֑ית וּבְלוּלִּ֗ים יַֽעֲלוּ֙ עַל־הַתִּ֣יכֹנָ֔ה וּמִן־הַתִּֽיכֹנָ֖ה אֶל־הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house: and they went up by winding stairs into the middle story, and out of the middle into the third.
controles.kjv: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.
controles.livre: A porta do aposento de em meio estava ao lado direito da casa: e subia-se por um caracol ao de em meio, e do aposento de em meio ao terceiro.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֥בֶן אֶת־הַבַּ֖יִת וַיְכַלֵּ֑הוּ וַיִּסְפֹּ֤ן אֶת־הַבַּ֨יִת֙ גֵּבִ֔ים וּשְׂדֵרֹ֖ת בָּאֲרָזִֽים׃

controles.web: So he built the house, and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.
controles.kjv: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
controles.livre: Lavrou, pois, a casa, e acabou-a; e cobriu a casa com artesanatos de cedro.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֤בֶן אֶת־היצוע עַל־כָּל־הַבַּ֔יִת חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֽוֹמָת֑וֹ וַיֶּאֱחֹ֥ז אֶת־הַבַּ֖יִת בַּעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִֽים׃פ

controles.web: He built the stories against all the house, each five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
controles.kjv: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
controles.livre: E edificou também o aposento em derredor de toda a casa, de altura de cinco côvados, o qual se apoiava na casa com madeiras de cedro.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s word came to Solomon, saying,
controles.kjv: And the word of the Lord came to Solomon, saying,
controles.livre: E foi palavra do SENHOR a Salomão, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: הַבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֜ה אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֣ה בֹנֶ֗ה אִם־תֵּלֵ֤ךְ בְּחֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֣י תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֥ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺתַ֖י לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּהֶ֑ם וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י אֶת־דְּבָרִי֙ אִתָּ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽיךָ׃

controles.web: “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.
controles.kjv: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:
controles.livre: Esta casa que tu edificas, se andares em meus estatutos, e fizeres meus direitos, e guardares todos meus mandamentos andando neles, eu terei firme contigo minha palavra que falei a Davi teu pai;

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁ֣כַנְתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֥א אֶעֱזֹ֖ב אֶת־עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”
controles.kjv: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
controles.livre: E habitarei em meio dos filhos de Israel, e não deixarei a meu povo Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֧בֶן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת־הַבַּ֖יִת וַיְכַלֵּֽהוּ׃

controles.web: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
controles.kjv: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
controles.livre: Assim que, Salomão preparou a casa, e acabou-a.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּבֶן֩ אֶת־קִיר֨וֹת הַבַּ֤יִת מִבַּ֨יְתָה֙ בְּצַלְע֣וֹת אֲרָזִ֔ים מִקַּרְקַ֤ע הַבַּ֨יִת֙ עַד־קִיר֣וֹת הַסִּפֻּ֔ן צִפָּ֥ה עֵ֖ץ מִבָּ֑יִת וַיְצַ֛ף אֶת־קַרְקַ֥ע הַבַּ֖יִת בְּצַלְע֥וֹת בְּרוֹשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar: from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood; and he covered the floor of the house with boards of fir.
controles.kjv: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
controles.livre: E preparou as paredes da casa por de dentro com tábuas de cedro, revestindo-a de madeira por dentro, desde o piso da casa até as paredes do teto: cobriu também o pavimento com madeira de faia.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּבֶן֩ אֶת־עֶשְׂרִ֨ים אַמָּ֜ה מירכותי הַבַּ֨יִת֙ בְּצַלְע֣וֹת אֲרָזִ֔ים מִן־הַקַּרְקַ֖ע עַד־הַקִּיר֑וֹת וַיִּ֤בֶן לוֹ֙ מִבַּ֣יִת לִדְבִ֔יר לְקֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: He built twenty cubits on the hinder part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling: he built them for it within, for an oracle, even for the most holy place.
controles.kjv: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.
controles.livre: Também fez ao fim da casa um edifício de vinte côvados de tábuas de cedro, desde o piso até o mais alto; e fabricou-se na casa um compartimento interno, que é o lugar santíssimo.

versos.hebraico: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים בָּאַמָּ֖ה הָיָ֣ה הַבָּ֑יִת ה֖וּא הַהֵיכָ֥ל לִפְנָֽי׃

controles.web: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits.
controles.kjv: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
controles.livre: E a casa, a saber, o templo de dentro, tinha quarenta côvados.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶ֤רֶז אֶל־הַבַּ֨יִת֙ פְּנִ֔ימָה מִקְלַ֣עַת פְּקָעִ֔ים וּפְטוּרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים הַכֹּ֣ל אֶ֔רֶז אֵ֥ין אֶ֖בֶן נִרְאָֽה׃

controles.web: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
controles.kjv: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
controles.livre: E a casa estava coberta de cedro por de dentro, e tinha entalhaduras de frutos silvestres e de botões de flores. Todo era cedro; nenhuma pedra se via.

versos.hebraico: וּדְבִ֧יר בְּתוֹךְ־הַבַּ֛יִת מִפְּנִ֖ימָה הֵכִ֑ין לְתִתֵּ֣ן שָׁ֔ם אֶת־אֲר֖וֹן בְּרִ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: He prepared an oracle in the midst of the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
controles.livre: E adornou o compartimento interno por de dentro no meio da casa, para pôr ali a arca do pacto do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַדְּבִ֡יר עֶשְׂרִים֩ אַמָּ֨ה אֹ֜רֶךְ וְעֶשְׂרִ֧ים אַמָּ֣ה רֹ֗חַב וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ קֽוֹמָת֔וֹ וַיְצַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וַיְצַ֥ף מִזְבֵּ֖חַ אָֽרֶז׃

controles.web: Within the oracle was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in its height; and he overlaid it with pure gold: and he covered the altar with cedar.
controles.kjv: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.
controles.livre: E o compartimento interno estava na parte de dentro, o qual tinha vinte côvados de comprimento, e outros vinte de largura, e outros vinte de altura; e revestiu-o de ouro puríssimo: também cobriu o altar de cedro.

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֨ף שְׁלֹמֹ֧ה אֶת־הַבַּ֛יִת מִפְּנִ֖ימָה זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וַיְעַבֵּ֞ר ברתיקות זָהָב֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַדְּבִ֔יר וַיְצַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he drew chains of gold across before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
controles.kjv: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
controles.livre: De sorte que revestiu Salomão de ouro puro a casa por de dentro, e fechou a entrada do compartimento interno com correntes de ouro, e revestiu-o de ouro.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־כָּל־הַבַּ֛יִת צִפָּ֥ה זָהָ֖ב עַד־תֹּ֣ם כָּל־הַבָּ֑יִת וְכָל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ אֲֽשֶׁר־לַדְּבִ֖יר צִפָּ֥ה זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: The whole house he overlaid with gold, until all the house was finished: also the whole altar that belonged to the oracle he overlaid with gold.
controles.kjv: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
controles.livre: Cobriu, pois, de ouro toda a casa até o fim; e também revestiu de ouro todo o altar que estava diante do compartimento interno.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ בַּדְּבִ֔יר שְׁנֵ֥י כְרוּבִ֖ים עֲצֵי־שָׁ֑מֶן עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: In the oracle he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.
controles.kjv: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
controles.livre: Fez também no compartimento interno dois querubins de madeira de oliva, cada um de altura de dez côvados.

versos.hebraico: וְחָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֗וֹת כְּנַ֤ף הַכְּרוּב֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וְחָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת כְּנַ֥ף הַכְּר֖וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֔וֹת מִקְצ֥וֹת כְּנָפָ֖יו וְעַד־קְצ֥וֹת כְּנָפָֽיו׃

controles.web: Five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing to the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
controles.kjv: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
controles.livre: A uma asa do querubim tinha cinco côvados, e a outra asa do querubim outros cinco côvados: assim que havia dez côvados desde a ponta da uma asa até a ponta da outra.

versos.hebraico: וְעֶ֨שֶׂר֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה הַכְּר֖וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֑י מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת וְקֶ֥צֶב אֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃

controles.web: The other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.
controles.kjv: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.
controles.livre: Também o outro querubim tinha dez côvados; porque ambos os querubins eram de um tamanho e de uma feitura.

versos.hebraico: קוֹמַת֙ הַכְּר֣וּב הָֽאֶחָ֔ד עֶ֖שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֑ה וְכֵ֖ן הַכְּר֥וּב הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃

controles.web: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
controles.kjv: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
controles.livre: A altura do um era de dez côvados, e também o outro.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִ֜ים בְּת֣וֹךְ׀ הַבַּ֣יִת הַפְּנִימִ֗י וַֽיִּפְרְשׂוּ֮ אֶת־כַּנְפֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִים֒ וַתִּגַּ֤ע כְּנַף־הָֽאֶחָד֙ בַּקִּ֔יר וּכְנַף֙ הַכְּר֣וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֔י נֹגַ֖עַת בַּקִּ֣יר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ הַבַּ֔יִת נֹגְעֹ֖ת כָּנָ֥ף אֶל־כָּנָֽף׃

controles.web: He set the cherubim within the inner house; and the wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
controles.kjv: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
controles.livre: E pôs estes querubins dentro da casa de dentro: os quais querubins estendiam suas asas, de modo que a asa do um tocava à parede, e a asa do outro querubim tocava à outra parede, e as outras duas asas se tocavam a uma à outra na metade da casa.

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֥ף אֶת־הַכְּרוּבִ֖ים זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.
controles.kjv: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
controles.livre: E revestiu de ouro os querubins.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֩ כָּל־קִיר֨וֹת הַבַּ֜יִת מֵסַ֣ב׀ קָלַ֗ע פִּתּוּחֵי֙ מִקְלְעוֹת֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים וְתִֽמֹרֹ֔ת וּפְטוּרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים מִלִּפְנִ֖ים וְלַחִיצֽוֹן׃

controles.web: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim and palm trees and open flowers, inside and outside.
controles.kjv: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
controles.livre: E esculpiu todas as paredes da casa ao redor de diversas figuras, de querubins, de palmas, e de botões de flores, por de dentro e por de fora.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־קַרְקַ֥ע הַבַּ֖יִת צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֑ב לִפְנִ֖ימָה וְלַחִיצֽוֹן׃

controles.web: The floor of the house he overlaid with gold, inside and outside.
controles.kjv: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
controles.livre: E cobriu de ouro o piso da casa, de dentro e de fora.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ פֶּ֣תַח הַדְּבִ֔יר עָשָׂ֖ה דַּלְת֣וֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁ֑מֶן הָאַ֥יִל מְזוּז֖וֹת חֲמִשִֽׁית׃

controles.web: For the entrance of the oracle he made doors of olive wood: the lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.
controles.kjv: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.
controles.livre: E à entrada do compartimento interno fez portas de madeira de oliva; e o umbral e os postes eram de cinco esquinas.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁתֵּי֮ דַּלְת֣וֹת עֲצֵי־שֶׁמֶן֒ וְקָלַ֣ע עֲ֠לֵיהֶם מִקְלְע֨וֹת כְּרוּבִ֧ים וְתִמֹר֛וֹת וּפְטוּרֵ֥י צִצִּ֖ים וְצִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֑ב וַיָּ֛רֶד עַל־הַכְּרוּבִ֥ים וְעַל־הַתִּֽמֹר֖וֹת אֶת־הַזָּהָֽב׃

controles.web: So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold; and he spread the gold on the cherubim, and on the palm trees.
controles.kjv: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.
controles.livre: As duas portas eram de madeira de oliva; e entalhou nelas figuras de querubins e de palmas e de botões de flores, e cobriu-as de ouro: cobriu também de ouro os querubins e as palmas.

versos.hebraico: וְכֵ֥ן עָשָׂ֛ה לְפֶ֥תַח הַֽהֵיכָ֖ל מְזוּז֣וֹת עֲצֵי־שָׁ֑מֶן מֵאֵ֖ת רְבִעִֽית׃

controles.web: So also made he for the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall;
controles.kjv: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.
controles.livre: Igualmente fez à porta do templo postes de madeira de oliva quadrados.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁתֵּ֥י דַלְת֖וֹת עֲצֵ֣י בְרוֹשִׁ֑ים שְׁנֵ֨י צְלָעִ֜ים הַדֶּ֤לֶת הָֽאַחַת֙ גְּלִילִ֔ים וּשְׁנֵ֧י קְלָעִ֛ים הַדֶּ֥לֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית גְּלִילִֽים׃

controles.web: and two doors of fir wood: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
controles.kjv: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
controles.livre: Porém as duas portas eram de madeira de faia; e os dois lados da uma porta eram redondos, e os outros dois lados da outra porta também redondos.

versos.hebraico: וְקָלַ֤ע כְּרוּבִים֙ וְתִ֣מֹר֔וֹת וּפְטֻרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים וְצִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֔ב מְיֻשָּׁ֖ר עַל־הַמְּחֻקֶּֽה׃

controles.web: He carved cherubim and palm trees and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.
controles.kjv: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
controles.livre: E entalhou nelas querubins e palmas e botões de flores, e cobriu-as de ouro ajustado às entalhaduras.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֨בֶן֙ אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔ית שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה טוּרֵ֣י גָזִ֑ית וְט֖וּר כְּרֻתֹ֥ת אֲרָזִֽים׃

controles.web: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone, and a course of cedar beams.
controles.kjv: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
controles.livre: E edificou o átrio interior de três ordens de pedras lavradas, e de uma ordem de vigas de cedro.

versos.hebraico: בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔ית יֻסַּ֖ד בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּיֶ֖רַח זִֽו׃

controles.web: In the fourth year was the foundation of Yahweh’s house laid, in the month Ziv.
controles.kjv: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the Lord laid, in the month Zif:
controles.livre: No quarto ano, no mês de Zife, se lançaram os alicerces da casa do SENHOR:

versos.hebraico: וּבַשָּׁנָה֩ הָאַחַ֨ת עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה בְּיֶ֣רַח בּ֗וּל ה֚וּא הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י כָּלָ֣ה הַבַּ֔יִת לְכָל־דְּבָרָ֖יו וּלְכָל־משפטו וַיִּבְנֵ֖הוּ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃

controles.web: In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all its parts, and according to all its fashion. So was he seven years in building it.
controles.kjv: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
controles.livre: E no décimo primeiro ano, no mês de Bul, que é o mês oitavo, foi acabada a casa com todas seus partes, e com todo o necessário. Edificou-a, pois, em sete anos.
